node.title: Re^3: Split string using regex on \n or max line length
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [flowdy],

You're right that my second regex didn't operate like the OP's, but if you write /(.{1,$len}\W?)/gm, then that may split in the middle of a word, like [id://1181638|your suggestion] and unlike the OP's regex. I've updated my node.

Thanks,
-- Hauke D
